planets.name: WASP-26 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-26 with a 2.76-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: WASP-26 b was found in 2010 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-26. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2010, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.75659784, pl_radj 1.21, pl_bmassj 0.85
